data: What is the approximate accuracy of the method represented with the green line when approximately 1000 labeled Chinese reviews are used?

The green line represents the ADAN method. The x-axis shows the number of labeled Chinese reviews, ranging from 10^2 to 10^4. The y-axis shows the accuracy. When the number of labeled Chinese reviews is approximately 1000, the green line reaches an accuracy of approximately 50%. Therefore, the approximate accuracy of the ADAN method when approximately 1000 labeled Chinese reviews are used is 50%.
